title: coax does not build against the current decade-channel
body:
coax depends on `decade-channel` by path, at `../decade/decade-channel`. Since decade c1acc26, `decade-channel` has changed its API, and coax no longer compiles against it:

- `decade_channel::code` (with `SHOW`, `MARK`, `Show`, `Mark`) is gone. `src/app.rs` and `src/follow.rs` import it.
- `Channel::from_env` takes a third argument, `&[Shows]`, the kinds the client can show. `connect_decade` in `src/app.rs` passes two.
- `Message` has new variants `Show`, `Highlight` and `Clear`, which the match in `App::decade` does not cover.

decade da499ce says the MCP tools `show`, `highlight` and `clear` replace `code.show`, `code.mark` and `code.clear`, and that a program lists the kinds it shows in hello's `shows` field. Follow-along in `src/follow.rs` sends `code.show` and `code.mark`, so it needs porting to the new verbs.

Until this is fixed, coax builds only with `decade-channel` taken from decade c1acc26, for example by pointing the path at a `git archive` of that commit. The archive keeps old file times, so touch the files first or cargo reuses a stale build.
close_reason: Fixed by removing follow-along, the only code on the old `decade_channel::code` API, and passing no kinds to `Channel::from_env`. Commit "Remove follow-along into decade's code pane" on dev.
